name: design-docs
description: Industry-grade documentation discipline for AI-driven engineering. Typed doc taxonomy (Feature LLD, Bug Report, ADR, Postmortem, Runbook, Design Doc), enforced gates (4-gate spec review + Refs: commit gate + bug iteration loop), mandatory mermaid diagrams, and AGENTS.md / llms.txt sync. Use whenever a feature, bug, decision, incident, runbook, or component architecture needs documentation before code.

config.comment_mode: Either 'solo' (skip RFC vocab, no review-committee phase) or 'team' (enable RFC vocab + reviewer assignment, recommended at 2+ senior engineers per industry canon).
config.comment_doc_paths: Override any path to point at your repo layout. Defaults match the canonical SCALE / industry layout.
config.comment_spec_review_skill: Skill name to invoke for Step 4.5 spec review. Set to null to skip. Default points at the superpowers plugin's review skill — change to your project's review skill if different.
